execution_scope: Zero scientific imports/calls/runs within this static v16 API review. Earlier theorem controls are read-only historical references, not repeated executions.
review_method: Read all public wrapper and private scalar core source
Read fixed runner, protocol, README, derivation, reference extraction and provenance
Manually verify directed gate, exact input boundaries and mathematical budgets
Parse Python syntax without importing or executing reviewed modules
Compare file digests and immutable origins

manual_checks.finding: Only exact rational input types; float and bool rejected. Fractions decide g>=P^2/m and all radii. Zero inputs precede divisions; H1=0 is exact.
Outward tau/S intervals; nonpositive only from Shi<=0, positive only from Slo>0, otherwise refusal. Pinned dependency and scale checked before gate evaluation.
Norm branch uses h=P^2/m; gap-active branch has h=g. Cheap bound explicitly clips h. Public joint parameters are keyword-only g,P; inherited internal positional P,g order is preserved.
At rho=h^2/P^2, n with coefficient 4K gives inner allowance <=(internal-1)h/2; no mesh. Separate rounding allowance and exact U<=factor*L check remain valid.
J based on actual width gives mesh <=(internal-1)g/4; coefficient 8K gives inner <=(internal-1)g/4. Both endpoints and the known lower bound g/2 are retained.
Exact Fraction h+(h^2/P^2)*Shi is a valid source-error upper bound. Separate UpperBound type has no requested/achieved factor or envelope lower bound. Positive or unresolved S refuses the shortcut.

New regime/algebraic scalar starts and gate sqrt/sign work are charged; node preflight includes spent gate work. Refusal carries no final bounds and retains partial diagnostic cost. Named counts are not total arithmetic or bit complexity.

Every copied source is checked directly against its reviewed hash before import. Freeze/review snapshots use initially captured hashes. Protocol and references are read from verified snapshot; API and core import paths are checked.

16 predeclared cases and fixed settings. No adaptive retry/tuning. Expected refusals, including low-precision unresolved gate, remain predictions until execution. Each result/failure and cost is retained.
